question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing right midfielder, Bob is playing left back, Claire is playing goalkeeper, Dave is playing benchwarmer, Eve is playing right winger, Fred is playing right back, and Gertrude is playing striker.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Dave and Alice trade positions. Then, Alice and Fred trade positions. Then, Fred and Gertrude trade positions. Then, Alice and Fred trade positions. Then, Dave and Gertrude trade positions. Then, Dave and Claire trade positions. Finally, Claire and Gertrude trade positions. At the end of the match, Dave is playing
Options:
(A) right midfielder
(B) left back
(C) goalkeeper
(D) benchwarmer
(E) right winger
(F) right back
(G) striker
solution:
Positions in each row are listed for Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude, in that order.
Initial: right midfielder, left back, goalkeeper, benchwarmer, right winger, right back, striker
1. Dave ↔ Alice: benchwarmer, left back, goalkeeper, right midfielder, right winger, right back, striker
2. Alice ↔ Fred: right back, left back, goalkeeper, right midfielder, right winger, benchwarmer, striker
3. Fred ↔ Gertrude: right back, left back, goalkeeper, right midfielder, right winger, striker, benchwarmer
4. Alice ↔ Fred: striker, left back, goalkeeper, right midfielder, right winger, right back, benchwarmer
5. Dave ↔ Gertrude: striker, left back, goalkeeper, benchwarmer, right winger, right back, right midfielder
6. Dave ↔ Claire: striker, left back, benchwarmer, goalkeeper, right winger, right back, right midfielder
7. Claire ↔ Gertrude: striker, left back, right midfielder, goalkeeper, right winger, right back, benchwarmer
Dave is playing goalkeeper, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
